text:
maria_cs: Heads-up — Orbitix asked for a temporary egress peering + rate-window increase scoped to EU for a customer-facing demo next week. Renewal conversation in ~6 weeks, this demo could materially impact their decision.

maria_cs: Details from Orbitix: they want region pin to eu-west, preserve session affinity, add IP allowlist, and bump the request rate-window to 1000 rpm (per API key) for 72 hours starting 2024-09-12T06:00Z. They prefer redwood-phi-v2 but will accept fallback to redwood-phi-v1. Provided IPs: 35.199.0.0/16, 34.107.0.0/16.

liam_se: assigning to SRE/Platform. Quick clarifying q's — do they need dedicated reserved capacity or just routing/peering + RL bump? Also, what is the masked API key/org id?

maria_cs: No reserved capacity requested — just routing/egress + temporary RL bump. Org ID: 01G7Z9X6. Masked key: sk-***f3a (I'll DM full key). Renewal risk: moderate-high, CS score 70. This demo is their exec-level pilot.

sam_sre: OK. We can implement a scoped rate_window increase and add a routing policy that pins traffic from their API key to eu-west. Need full API key for config, and confirmation of start/end times (timezone UTC OK). We'll attach a TTL for the change (72h) and automated rollback.

kara_eng: I can push the region pin and session-affinity sticky cookie via routing policy. Two questions: 1) Do we want an explicit fallback region if eu-west is busy (e.g., eu-central)? 2) Any model transform/quantization constraints?

maria_cs: Fallback to eu-central is fine but must be lower priority than eu-west. No special quantization or custom model weights. Stick with redwood-phi-v2 -> redwood-phi-v1 fallback.

aisha_ops: Egress peering + direct peering requests usually need commerce/legal signoff if they want BGP/ASN peering. If it's only IP allowlist + routing pin, ops can do it without POA. Clarify whether Orbitix asked for peering or just allowlist.

maria_cs: They wrote "egress peering" in email but clarified on call they mean to ensure our egress IPs are whitelisted on their firewall — so IP allowlist only. No BGP peering required.

devbot: @sam_sre created ticket INF-4821: "Orbitix temporary EU region pin + 1000rpm rate-window (72h)"

sam_sre: Taking INF-4821. Plan: 1) apply routing policy pin for org 01G7Z9X6 to eu-west; 2) bump rate_window for API key to 1000 rpm with 72h TTL; 3) register fallback to eu-central with lower weight; 4) tag change for billing/CS notes. ETA ~2 hours from now.

maria_cs: Please add an enablement slot — customer wants a 30-min walkthrough at T-24h. Also capture feedback form post-demo.

sam_sre: Will do. I'll also annotate the change with a rollback hook and an alert escalation to eng-oncall if latency > 600ms p50.

sam_sre: Config snippet to apply (masking values here):

```json
{
  "org_id": "01G7Z9X6",
  "api_key_mask": "sk-***f3a",
  "rate_window": 1000,
  "window_ttl": 259200, // 72h in seconds
  "routing": {
    "primary_region": "eu-west",
    "fallback_regions": ["eu-central"],
    "session_affinity": true
  },
  "allowed_ips": ["35.199.0.0/16", "34.107.0.0/16"]
}
```

devbot: INF-4821 status: in_progress (assigned to sam_sre)

sam_sre: Applied routing policy and rate_window bump at 1729501800. Billing tag "cs-temp-bump-orbitix" attached. Monitoring hooks added.

deploybot: config-change: INF-4821 completed by sam_sre at 1729501805. Changes: routing.pin(eu-west), rate_window=1000 (TTL 72h), fallback eu-central, IP allowlist added.

maria_cs: Confirmed with Orbitix — they can see EU traffic pinned and demo traffic looks good. They appreciated the quick turnaround. Scheduled enablement: 2024-09-11T06:30Z (30 min).

liam_se: I'll add a short post-demo eval to track token-level latencies and any quality regressions due to fallback model.

maria_cs: Orbitix flagged one small issue: some global SDK endpoints cached older IPs; they cleared DNS TTL and it resolved. Note for docs: recommend including DNS TTL step for customers whitelisting our IPs.

sam_sre: INF-4821 will auto-revert at 1729689000 (72h TTL). Manually closing after post-demo check.

maria_cs: Customer verbal feedback: demo positive, ask to discuss a reserved pool during renewal. Marking renewal risk as decreased. Thanks all :thumbsup:

deploybot: INF-4821 status: scheduled_revert at 1729689000.

maria_cs: Closing thread — please add notes to the renewal playbook (Orbitix: discuss reserved capacity + formal peering if needed).
